tools.name: next_election
tools.description: The next elections in one country, however far ahead: polling day and whether it is declared, still tentative, or only expected within a period, what is elected, the counting authority, and when results are expected. Answers "When is the next election in Austria?" or "When are the US midterms?". Nat

tools.name: upcoming_elections
tools.description: List elections by date range and/or country, soonest first, with each race's expected count stage right now. Answers "Which elections are in Europe this autumn?", "Which elections are this month?" or "What elections does Germany have coming up?". Without dates it starts today; with a country and no

tools.name: poll_blackout
tools.description: Whether a country bans publishing opinion polls before a vote, checked now: verdict ban / no-ban / exit-polls-only / unverified, when a ban starts and ends (polls close), whether it is in force, the law and article, and the official text it was read in. tools.name: pollster
tools.description: A pollster's final published poll before each election we hold a certified result for, set against that result: share per party or candidate, error in points, mean absolute error, and the error on the winner's margin. Figures come from the pollster's own release or a registry, never an aggregator. M

tools.name: election_status
tools.description: Full record of one election: races, polls-close times, every count stage window (exit poll, election night, intermediate count, final result, government) with confidence and citation, the authority, sources, recorded vote counts, whether the record is stale, whether a poll-publication ban (poll_blac

tools.name: when_final
tools.description: When will a race's final (certified) result exist? Returns the expected window, its confidence (announced / precedent / estimate) and basis, how many days the final took last time, and the final count itself once we hold it. Use this before asking or settling any "final result" question.

tools.name: check_question
tools.description: Is a question about a given count stage answerable at a given time? Returns verdict ok / too-early / inside-window / too-late, settle_after, and the resolvable sources. Built to stop questions that read the provisional count when they mean the final one.

tools.name: resolution_sources
tools.description: Every known source URL for a race, classified (race_results, feed, results_index, emb_home, directory, media). Only race_results and feed can answer a results question; homepages never can. A results page whose HTML shows no count once one is due (figures_in_html false) is not resolvable. Sources a

tools.name: submit_correction
tools.description: Report a mistake or a missing election, with a URL that proves it (ideally the official authority page). The report is public and is checked like any other claim; it never changes the data by itself. Returns the report id; follow it at https://electionindex.org/corrections.

tools.name: dataset_health
tools.description: Coverage, stale records, races still lacking a results page, and publisher-gate warnings, as counts with the first 20 of each (full report at /v1/health). Use to judge how far to trust an answer.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "upcoming_elections" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
